messages:
dev-support: FYI customer 'acme-corp' reporting a sudden spike of 502s from Hosted API around 09:12 UTC. They say it started after a billing retry storm. Trace id: abc123def. Sample request attached.

dev-support: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}' 

sam-m: thx. any concrete repro steps from customer? single request or bursts?

dev-support: They see it in production under normal traffic but spikes when billing backend SLOs slip — client sends payment metadata, hosted api fanout to billing proxy then 502. They sent a small log: 

  [2025-03-18T09:12:04Z] request_id=abc123 upstream=billing-proxy timeout=200ms status=502 "upstream reset"
  [2025-03-18T09:12:04Z] envoy: retries=4 upstream_reset reason=connect_failed

indra: looks like a retry amplification at the edge. Envoy retry + client retries + billing proxy queueing -> upstream exhaustion. Can you paste the full request headers and approximate QPS?

dev-support: headers: 
  x-tenant: acme-prod
  x-customer-id: 3829
  content-type: application/json
  x-request-meta: billing=true

QPS during spike: ~120 rps (normally 35).

sam-m: 120 from that tenant is significant. Did we see increased latency to billing service in traces? any 5xx from billing itself?

ops-ryan: checked traces — billing backend started showing 500/503 intermittently and p95 latencies jumped to 600ms at 09:11. Edge was configured to retry on 5xx with 3 attempts and short timeouts, so we amplified. I can temporary reduce retries and raise the upstream timeout to avoid resets.

dev-support: customer asks for ETA to mitigation, they are impacted.

customer-success-liz: we need a quick customer message: "We're investigating increased 502 errors and applying mitigation to reduce retries. Will update in 15m." can ops confirm?

ops-ryan: doing now. Will patch edge policy: set envoy retry count to 0 for routes with x-request-meta=billing, bump upstream timeout from 200ms -> 1s, enable 503 circuit-breaker fallback to cached billing response. Applying change to canary first.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated by ops-ryan: patch routes/ingress/billing-rewrite -> set retry_policy.count=0, timeout.ms=1000, cb.threshold=5. Canary scope=eu1, 10% traffic.

deploy-bot: canary successful (10% -> 0 errors), promoting to 100% in 30s.

ops-ryan: promoted. I'm also throttling the tenant at frontdoor to cap to 50 rps while billing recovers.

indra: good. follow-up: we should add a synthetic monitor on billing latency and an automated rollback if we see retry amplification. Also add a short-term rule to tag requests that touch billing so we can filter metrics.

sam-m: for postmortem capture: trace ids (abc123def, abc123fed, abc124000), edge logs, envoy metrics (upstream_rq_total, upstream_rq_5xx, upstream_rq_retry). Grab heap/connections on billing-proxy.

dev-support: grabbed edge logs and uploaded to s3: https://s3.redwood-infra/triage/1800000001/edge-logs.tar.gz

customer-success-liz: sent customer update: "Mitigation applied: reduced retries and throttled tenant while we investigate billing backend. We're monitoring and will follow up with RCA."

ops-ryan: monitoring looks stable for last 3m after config change. 502 rate down to baseline. Keeping throttle for 10 more minutes.

sam-m: quick note: long-term fix options: (1) make billing proxy idempotent + accept single-shot requests (2) change client SDK backoff to avoid synchronized retries (3) add a queue/async acknowledgement for billing writes.

indra: also add an edge-level heuristic: if upstream 5xx rate rising, automatically disable edge retries for that upstream for N minutes.

dev-support: will open a follow-up ticket for the PM/R&D on SDK and billing design.

customer-success-liz: customer replied: "Thanks — errors reduced and we see normal traffic now. Please share RCA."

ops-ryan: saving action items:
- keep throttle in place until billing team confirms fix
- run billing-proxy memory/conn checks and restart if unhealthy
- add automated retry-disable rule (indra)
- document customer-facing timeline (dev-support + liz)

sam-m: assign owners and I can help write the RCA.

dev-support: Owners added: billing-team (postmortem), eng-runtime for edge heuristics, client-sdks for backoff.

deploy-bot: change completed and recorded in rollout-1234 by ops-ryan at 2025-03-18T09:14:12Z :white_check_mark:

ops-ryan: marking thread resolved for now. Will reopen if errors recur. :thumbsup:
